caption: The video captures a wide coastal seascape beneath a heavy layered cloud bank at dusk or dawn. The sun is concealed behind a central gap in the clouds, throwing soft crepuscular rays downward toward the horizon. A low mountain ridge silhouettes the far shore, with faint wind-turbine shapes dotting its right side. The middle ground holds a calm sea whose surface ripples continuously, its light reflections shifting subtly from frame to frame. In the immediate foreground, scattered dark rocks rest along the shoreline, their positions unchanged throughout. The glow around the hidden sun and the edges of the rays shimmer gently in intensity, consistent with light filtering through a broken cloud layer. The large central cloud mass and the upper-right clouds drift only imperceptibly. The framing of rocks, horizon and mountains stays steady throughout.
